code=" def return import self print class elif lambda None True False range len for while if else try except yield async await const var function let int void public static std include println".split()
codesym=["()","):","{","}","[]","==","!=","+=","->","::","__","#","//","/*","\n    ","    ",");","()\n","='",'="']
prose=" the and of house water happy mountain river city friend story beautiful yesterday family music garden".split()
def ids(ws): 
    out=[]
    for w in ws:
        t=encode(w if w.startswith((" ","\n")) or not w.isalpha() else " "+w)
        if len(t)>=1: out.append(t[-1] if len(t)>1 else t[0])
    return sorted(set(out))
C=ids(code)+ids(codesym); P=ids(prose)
print(len(C),len(P))
res={}
for L in range(2,24):
    g=W(f'model.layers.{L}.feed_forward.gate.weight')
    gc=(En[C]@g.T).mean(0); gp=(En[P]@g.T).mean(0)
    d=(gc-gp); top=torch.argsort(d,descending=True)[:4]
    # logit lens of expert down proj: mean output direction
    sc=[]
    for e in range(32):
        w2=W(f'model.layers.{L}.feed_forward.experts.{e}.w2.weight') # [2048,1792]
        u,s,v=torch.svd_lowrank(w2,q=8)
        lg=(En@u)  # vocab x 8
        sc.append(((lg[C]**2).mean()-(lg[P]**2).mean()).item())
    sc=torch.tensor(sc); t2=torch.argsort(sc,descending=True)[:4]
    print(L,'router',top.tolist(),[round(x,3) for x in d[top].tolist()],'| w2',t2.tolist(),[round(x,4) for x in sc[t2].tolist()])

args.code:
import torch,json
E=W('model.embed_tokens.weight'); En=E/E.norm(dim=1,keepdim=True)
dig=[encode(str(i))[-1] for i in range(10)]+[encode(' '+str(i))[-1] for i in range(10)]
dig=sorted(set(dig))
words=[encode(' '+w)[-1] for w in "the house water happy mountain river city friend story beautiful family music garden table window paper green light".split()]
dmean=En[dig].mean(0); wmean=En[words].mean(0); dirv=dmean-wmean; dirv/=dirv.norm()
for L in (0,1):
    w1=W(f'model.layers.{L}.feed_forward.w1.weight'); w3=W(f'model.layers.{L}.feed_forward.w3.weight'); w2=W(f'model.layers.{L}.feed_forward.w2.weight').T
    # input side: response to digit embeddings vs words (gate*up)
    act=lambda ids:(torch.nn.functional.silu(En[ids]@w1.T)*(En[ids]@w3.T)).abs().mean(0)
    a=act(dig)-act(words)
    o=(w2/w2.norm(dim=1,keepdim=True))@dirv
    s=a/a.std()+o/o.std()
    for K in (128,256):
        idx=torch.topk(s,K).indices.tolist()
        json.dump({'kind':'mlp_cluster','layer':L,'indices':idx},open(f'/work/digit_l{L}_{K}.json','w'))
    print(L,'top s',torch.topk(s,5).values.tolist(),'a/o corr',torch.corrcoef(torch.stack([a,o]))[0,1].item())

args.weight_rationale: L0 dense MLP units ranked by digit-vs-word input response (silu(w1·e)*(w3·e) on digit embeddings minus word embeddings) plus w2 cosine to the digit-minus-word unembedding direction; top 128.
L1 dense MLP units ranked by digit-vs-word input response plus w2 alignment with the digit-minus-word unembedding direction; top 128.
